description: This file defines the MapContext class, which provides a combined view over a collection of maps organized in a deque, supporting layered map operations with push/pop functionality and custom key/value retrieval.

classes.name: MapContext
classes.description: A class implementing Map that overlays multiple maps organized in a deque, allowing layered map operations with push/pop functionality.

methods.name: getContexts
methods.description: Returns the deque of maps representing the contexts.

methods.name: push
methods.description: Adds a new empty map to the top of the context stack.

methods.name: push
methods.description: Adds an existing map to the top of the context stack.

methods.name: addToBottom
methods.description: Adds an existing map to the bottom of the context stack.

methods.name: pop
methods.description: Removes and returns the top map from the stack if more than one map exists.

methods.name: size
methods.description: Returns the total number of unique keys across all maps.

methods.name: isEmpty
methods.description: Checks if all maps in the context are empty.

methods.name: entryStream
methods.description: Creates a stream of map entries, filtering out duplicate keys.

methods.name: containsKey
methods.description: Checks if any map contains the specified key.

methods.name: containsValue
methods.description: Checks if any map contains the specified value.

methods.name: withContextContainingKey
methods.description: Helper to find a value for a key in the first map that contains it.

methods.name: get
methods.description: Retrieves the value for a key, searching through the layered maps.

methods.name: get
methods.description: Retrieves a localized value for a key considering locale, if the map supports localization.

methods.name: put
methods.description: Puts a key-value pair into the top map.

methods.name: remove
methods.description: Removes a key from the top map.

methods.name: putAll
methods.description: Puts all entries from a given map into the top map.

methods.name: clear
methods.description: Clears the top map.

methods.name: keySet
methods.description: Returns an unmodifiable set of all keys across all maps.

methods.name: values
methods.description: Returns an unmodifiable collection of all values across all maps.

methods.name: entrySet
methods.description: Returns an unmodifiable set of all entries across all maps.

methods.name: toString
methods.description: Returns a string representation of the layered maps with stack levels.
